layout: Single screen, light bg (#F8FAFC). Content is vertically centered with consistent spacing. IDENTICAL LAYOUT to Step 1 and Step 2 — only the middle content changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Ghost back arrow (top-left, active navy #003F8C). NO 'Skip for now' (last step).
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered below top bar: 3 dot circles. Step 1: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 2: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 3: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled.
layout_structure.heading: 'Your Schedule' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Kapan kamu biasanya workout?' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.content_area: Day chips row + time toggle cards + selection summary
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Get Started' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius, shadow. ALWAYS ACTIVE (can proceed with no selection).
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between each section. 16px horizontal padding on mobile, 32px on desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, navy #003F8C, active) left. No skip link (last step cannot be skipped).
PROGRESS: 3 horizontal dots. Dot 1: green (#22C55E) filled circle. Dot 2: green (#22C55E) filled circle. Dot 3: orange (#FF8A34) filled circle.
SUBTITLE: 'Kapan kamu biasanya workout?' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.

DAY CHIPS: Horizontal row, 7 chips, 6px gap, centered. Labels: Sen, Sel, Rab, Kam, Jum, Sab, Min. Each: pill 999px, 10px/16px padding, 14px text. Unselected: bg #F1F5F9, text #64748B. Selected: bg #003F8C, white text. Multi-select (tap toggle on/off).
LABEL: 'Preferred time' in slate small (14px), left-aligned, with 16px top margin.

TIME CARDS: 3 horizontal cards (stack on mobile), 12px gap. Each: white bg, 12px radius, subtle shadow, 16px padding. Icon (large) top, label below, description below. Unselected: gray border. Selected: orange (#FF8A34) border 2px + checkmark.
SELECTION SUMMARY: Small card below time cards, only visible when day(s) selected. Blue bg (#EFF6FF), blue text (#003F8C). Calendar icon + 'Sen, Rab, Jum • Sore'.
CTA: 'Get Started' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius, shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(255,138,52,0.3). Always active.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to 03a and 03b — top bar, progress dots, icon, heading, subtitle, CTA are all in same position. CTA changes to 'Get Started' (entering app). Selection summary card only appears after first selection.
